name: @crissmoldovan/agent-lifecycle
description: Portable progress, reconciliation, and visibility for delegated agents.

scripts.check:package: node --input-type=module -e "const p=JSON.parse(await (await import('node:fs/promises')).readFile('package.json','utf8')); const e=p.exports?.['.']; const hermes=p.exports?.['./hermes-delegation-reconciliation']; if(!p.private||p.version!=='0.3.0'||p.license!=='MIT'||p.type!=='module'||p.main!=='./dist/index.js'||p.types!=='./dist/index.d.ts'||e?.import!=='./dist/index.js'||e?.types!=='./dist/index.d.ts'||hermes?.import!=='./dist/hermes-delegation-reconciliation.js'||hermes?.types!=='./dist/hermes-delegation-reconciliation.d.ts'||!Array.isArray(p.files)||!p.files.includes('dist/')||p.engines?.node!=='>=24.0.0'||!p.scripts?.clean||!p.scripts?.build||!p.scripts?.['verify:package']) throw new Error('package metadata does not match release policy'); console.log('package metadata OK')"
scripts.check:markdown: node --input-type=module -e "const fs=await import('node:fs/promises'); const path=await import('node:path'); async function walk(d){const entries=await fs.readdir(d,{withFileTypes:true}); return (await Promise.all(entries.flatMap(e=>e.name==='.git'||e.name==='node_modules'||e.name==='dist'?[]:e.isDirectory()?walk(path.join(d,e.name)):e.name.endsWith('.md')?[path.join(d,e.name)]:[]))).flat()} const files=await walk('.'); if(!files.length) throw new Error('no Markdown files found'); for(const f of files){const s=await fs.readFile(f,'utf8'); if(!s.trim()||!s.endsWith('\n')) throw new Error('invalid Markdown file: '+f)} console.log('Markdown hygiene OK ('+files.length+' files)')"
scripts.verify: npm run check:package && npm run check:markdown && npm run check:types && npm test && npm run build && npm run verify:package
